title: Graph-Enhanced Disease Trajectory Discovery and Temporal Endpoint Forecasting from Longitudinal Electronic Health Records
abstract: arXiv:2610.20502v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Longitudinal electronic health records (EHRs) can reveal disease-progression structure, while useful forecasting requires leakage-controlled discovery, censor-aware outcomes, and inspectable trajectory evidence. We developed a graph-enhanced framework in MIMIC-IV v3.1 that splits patients before graph construction, learns train-only consecutive-admission transitions, and freezes endpoint-specific branching-motif policies selected on validation data. The final catalog contained 99,527 motifs, and a time-aware Transformer retrieved at most 24 patient-compatible motifs per endpoint through endpoint-specific cross-attention. translated_title: 基于纵向电子健康记录的图增强疾病轨迹发现与时序终点预测
translated_abstract: 纵向电子健康记录（EHR）能够揭示疾病进展的结构，而有效的预测需要泄漏可控的发现方法、考虑删失的结局以及可检验的轨迹证据。我们在MIMIC-IV v3.1数据集上开发了一个图增强框架：在构建图之前对患者进行划分，仅从训练集中学习连续入院的转移关系，并冻结在验证数据上筛选出的针对特定终点的分支模式策略。最终的模式目录包含99,527个模式（motifs），一个时间感知的Transformer通过针对特定终点的交叉注意力机制，为每个终点最多检索24个与患者兼容的模式。在五个训练种子上，micro-AUPRC从0.9330提升至0.9357，同时事件时间的MAE从676.9天降至657.7天（减少19.2天；95%配对患者聚类自助法置信区间为13.8-24.8）。时间效应呈现异质性：730天内事件的MAE有所恶化，而对于更晚发生的事件则改善了58.9天。
tldr: 该研究提出了一种在MIMIC-IV上实现泄漏控制的图增强疾病轨迹模式发现框架，结合时间感知Transformer进行终点预测，使事件时间预测误差平均降低19.2天。
en_tdlr: A leakage-controlled graph-enhanced framework discovers disease trajectory branching motifs from longitudinal EHRs and, combined with a time-aware Transformer, reduces event-time forecasting error by 19.2 days on MIMIC-IV.
